## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design multi-tenant ML workflows with strict data isolation, governance, and cost controls. It also evaluates integration of stream/batch processing, feature reuse, and safe deployment in production environments.

## Key Concepts
- Multi-tenant data isolation with tenant-scoped feature stores
- Canary and blue-green deployment strategies with rollback criteria
- Data provenance and governance using BigQuery and Cloud Storage
- Budget and drift monitoring with Vertex AI and Dataflow

## Code Example
```python
# High-level pseudo-code for merchant-specific training
def train_for_merchant(merchant_id: str, config: TrainingConfig):
    features = feature_store.get_features(
        entity_id=merchant_id,
        feature_ids=config.feature_ids
    )
    
    training_data = dataflow.transform(
        source=f'gs://raw-events/merchant_id={merchant_id}',
        transformation=config.preprocessing
    )
    
    model = vertex_ai.train(
        dataset=training_data,
        custom_job_config=config.job_spec
    )
    
    # Canary deployment with budget guardrails
    deployed_model = vertex_ai.deploy_canary(
        model=model,
        traffic_split={'candidate': 10, 'baseline': 90}
    )
    
    monitor = BudgetDriftMonitor(deployed_model)
    if monitor.detect_anomaly():
        monitor.trigger_rollback()
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests advanced GCP ML integration with privacy compliance, multi-tenant isolation, and governance in a real-world healthcare setting. Requires concrete orchestration of Pub/Sub, Dataflow, per-tenant Feature Stores, Vertex AI training/serving, and auditable explainability.

## Key Concepts
- HIPAA-compliant data handling and PHI de-identification
- Per-tenant data isolation and feature storage
- Private endpoints and RBAC in Vertex AI
- Canary rollout, drift detection, and automated rollback
- Audit trails and model explainability logging in BigQuery

## Code Example
```python
# Pseudo-beam/Dataflow de-identification pipeline
import apache_beam as beam
from google.cloud import dlp

class DeidentifyPHI(beam.DoFn):
    def __init__(self, project_id):
        self.project_id = project_id
        self.dlp_client = dlp.DlpServiceClient()
    
    def process(self, element):
        # Inspect and de-identify PHI using DLP
        inspect_config = {'info_types': [{'name': 'PHI'}]}
        deidentify_config = {
            'info_type_transformations': {
                'transformations': [{'info_type': {'name': 'PHI'}, 'primitive_transformation': {'replace_with_info_type_config': {}}}]
            }
        }
        item = {'value': element}
        response = self.dlp_client.deidentify_content(
            parent=f'projects/{self.project_id}',
            inspect_config=inspect_config,
            deidentify_config=deidentify_config,
            item=item
        )
        yield response.item.value
```
